translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: ROM
book.title: ROM Pol ere Rom komri tatame emne bas rasem siglou.

content: Pol eteri aposel kerebetem yaku ere wusowum.

An Pol, an kemne Rom komri tatame kemne siglou basbe. An Jisas Krais eteri yaku kerebe tame. God ere ane peten won yim, ere ane etep wom. Ne ari tuma yenbo wusoubetete. Etep wom, an God eteri won yim tame tem.
Kiyisape God ere eteri tuma wusoubetem tame emne tuma wusoubetem. Ere nowselri tatame emne sene pette tuma emne wusoubetem. Wusoubetem, ete Tuma Yenbo eme God eteri Siglou Yenbok basem.
Ete tuma yenbo e gwopkap. God Eteri Yen ere more tamek tem. Ere Keryen Devit eteri nan. Ere Jisas Krais, neremri Aneyen.
Ere sam, God ere eteri mure eisauke erne wou sene newom, Jisas ere sene wayen yim. Etep tem, God ere nemne peteram, Jisas ere Eteri Yen yenbowai.
Krais eterke God ere nemne kobo lan nemne tuma wusoute yaku kerete won yim. Etepkap akeite akeite nowselri tatame eme Jisas Krais erne kenawaike abon eri tuma noub meten tobobe.
Kerem Romri tatame, keremne God ere kemne kir wopetem, kem Jisas Krais eteri tatame tem.

Etepkap an kemne Rom tatame kemne gwo siglou basbe. God ere kemne pap yewobe. Ere kemne wopetem, kem eteri tatame tem. An abobe, neremri Apei God eterken neremri Aneyen Jisas Kraisken epe kemne noub nenbetete, kem pap yenbo temente.
Pol ere Romri Kristen emne yin late abom.
Metye. Kiyi an areri God erne pir wobe. Nogwape komri tatame eme metbe, kem Jisas Krais erne kenawaike abobe tatame. Eke an kemne akei abon Jisas Krais eteri sigke an God erne pir wobe.
God eteri yaku an muresen kerebe, Eteri Yen eri tuma yenbo an muresen wusoube. Eter ere metbe, an eterken tuma namdebe, an kemne kir abon eterken namdebe. Tewok tewok an etep tebe.
Kiyi an kemne yan late kelu lawoyim, eke an God erne som wometbe, ere ane kelu newote. Ere kir wotek, an kemne yan late.
Mapeke an kemne late abobe? God Eteri Wou ere tatame emne newobe mure an kemne newote abobe. An kemne newote, kem mureken tete.

Ari woye tuma eri somo ere gwo. Nema awoawo kobo late. Kem toboten kenawaike abobe wule an late, ari toboten kenawaike abobe wule ere eisau tete. An toboten kenawaike abobe wule kem late, kemri toboten kenawaike abobe wule ere eisau kir tete. An yate, nema etep tete.

Kristen geisimase, an abobe, kem mette, tewok tewok an kemne yan late wobetem, wos nogwape ane keresukbetem. Juda tame berai tame, an emne God eteri tuma wusoubetem, eme kenawaike meten Kristen temkap, an keremri komke yin etepkap nente abobe.

God ere ane noub nenbetem, eke an tatame nogwape emne noub awosein yenbo nente abobe. Grik tameken Grik berai tameken an emne noub awosein yenbo nente nenbe. Porereken tame, porereken berai tameken an emne noub awosein yenbo nente nenbe.
Eke God eteri tuma yenbo an kemne Romri tatame kemne kir wusoute kenawaike abobe.
God eri tuma yenbo ere mureken.

Ete Tuma Yenbo an sebera beke ya. Ete tuma e God eteri mureken. Ete murek God ere tatame emne sene petbe. Tatame eme ete tuma kenawaike mette, God ere etem nenbe wule yaper peten sepitin ere emne pette wom. Juda tatame eme ete tuma kiyi metbetem, sene Juda berai tatame nogwape eme kir metbe.

God eteri Tuma Yenbok God ere nemne peterabe, ere tatame emne noub nenbe. Kenawaike abobe wulewouke ere tatame emne noub nenbe. Tasen yin omote, Krais erne kenawaike aboten tatame etemnewou God ere noub nenbe. Gwotek basten tuma etep wobe. Kenawaike abobe tatame emne God ere tatame yenbo wobe. Eme noub somsom temente.
Tame nogwape eme God erne magel taibe.

Nema metten. Nowselri tatame eme God erne magel taibe, eme wule yaper nenbe. Etep tebe, eme God eteri wule teitkwunbe. God ere Hevenke tetan, ere emne lan pap wayebe, ere emne yaper awosein nente nenbe.
God ere eteri wule emne noub peterabe. Peterabe, eme mo won erne magel taibe, eke God ere emne pap wayebe.

God ere nelken selken seikim yabelke gwotepte kir, tatame eme God erne lek beke la. Erne beke la, eme eter seikim wos kuyese labe. Etep labe, eme kuyese metem, mure eisauken God ere tetan. Etepkap tetan, tatame eme mapeke wo. God ere beke te, eke nema neremri porerewouke nenbe. Etep wobe tatame God ere emne tuma namdete, eme mapeke awosein wo.

God ere tetan, eme etep metten. Metten, eme eteri sig eisau beke wo. Eme erne pir beke wo. Eme erne sukye beke wora, etepkap eme me eiksebe. Emri porere et porere yaper, emri selpap neirkap teketeten.
Eme etep wobe. Nema porereken tame. Etep wobe, eme porereken berai. Eme me eiksebe.

Somsom temente mureken God eterne eme erne sukye worate mo wobe. Etep wobe, eme memake regen sukye worabe. Por, ap, sopo o more tamekap wos eme mek regbe, eme ete memake sukye worabe. Som beke te wos eme sukye worabe.
Tatame nogwape eme wule yaper nenbe.

Eme etep nenbe, God ere etep wom. Eme wule yaper som nenbe, eme som wan gwolebe. Etepkap an emne noub beke nen. Eme wule yaper som nente, e etemri wos. Eme etemri selpap maime yaper nenbe. Etep wom, tatame eme wule yaper som nenbe, etemri wusom awoawo yaper nenbe.

Eme God eteri tuma seken magelke taibe. Taibe, eme yikwokwo yakwokwo tuma metbe. Metbe, eme God eter seikim woskap lan eme memake etepkap regbe, sukye tare nenbe. Nenbe, eme ete woswou sukye woran kulke temenbe. Nowselri wos akei seikim God eterne eme sukye worate mo wobe. Nema abobe, eri sig eisau som wobetete. E seken.
Eme etep tem, etepkap God ere etep wom. Eme wule yaper som nente, e etemri wos. Etep wom, etemri ta eme tame yibe wule mesginin eme taken tuknabe.
Tame eme kir. Eme ta panebe wule mesginin eme pap wayen akeite tameken tuknabe. Eme wule yaper etep nenbe, etepkap eme tokwo yaper petbe, emri wusomken selpapken yaper tebe.
Eme God erne abote mo wobe, etepkap God ere etep wom. Eme etemri selpap yaper tete wos nente, e etemri wos. Etep wom, eme wule yaperwai som nenbe.

Etep tebe, eme akeite akeite wule yaper som nenbe. Eme ete tameri wos metekwasbe, eme tame emne yaper nenbe. Be wos be wosken tame emne eme selpap yaper tebe, eme tame alwo pen sabe, eme ei naibe, eme tuma yikwokwobe. Eme tatame emne tuma yaper wobe, eme kerebe tuma wobe.
Eme tatame wuswaibe. Eme God erne peiktame tebe, eme wan gwole tebe, eme etemri sig maime eisau wobe. Eme be wos be wos yaper etemri porerek nenbe. Eme anenawoken emri tuma beke met.
Emri porere yaper. Eme tumak bepou me wobe. Eme komri tatame emne kobo beke la, eme emne pap beke yewo.

God eri tuma etep wobe. Etepkap yaper nenbe tatame emne an pen sate. Etep wobe. Ete tatame eme etep metbe, eme ete tuma wanwouke metbe. Eme wule yaper som nenbe. Som nenbe, eme tamek nenbe wos yaper lan kir wobe.
